compiled_kernel_resources.scope: Static compiler declarations, not measured occupancy.

machine_code_diagnostic.scope: Read-only disassembly of the measured executable. Many individual16-bit operand loads and execution-mask changes remain in the K loop; input eligibility reload is visible in the whole-dot loop. Zero-C matrix operands and following scalar additions are present. No scratch accesses found. These static observations do not establish the measured slowdown cause.

implementation: One uninterrupted zero-C signed BF16 WMMA path retains only the complete native partial sum and its maximum through K. Compute one final envelope instead of per-block center/error updates. Four coalesced FP32 L2/max summaries per operand row cover disjoint quarter-dot K16 segments, including empty/unequal segments for short tails. At most64 lane additions plus five shuffle levels fit the existing20ppm norm allowance. Sum the quarter norm products for a conservative absolute dot, and maximize their individual-product bounds. The final fixed-point barrier bounds every original carry, individual product and pre-normalization sum; its outward denominator explicitly handles odd group counts. Charge every native scalar addition and all21 original alignment/normalization units per K16. The native2^-19 coefficient remains conditional. Prefix snapshots contain native sums and matrix-error allowances for only the remaining quarters; one global per-step error bounds the same original path. After each exact segment, combine the canonical carry and native remaining sum with explicit subtraction/addition bounds. Compact unresolved original carries between kernels. Complete replay is also measured with and without snapshot stores.
correctness_scope: Sanitized tests use independent original wide canonical arithmetic for widths16/80/272/512/2048/4096/8192 under three modeled native errors. Check every interior carry against the final barrier, every final interval and all sampled suffix certificates. Metadata tests include empty quarters and all lengths through2048. Native cases cover the same short/odd tails, signed zeros, cancellation, unsupported operands and large widths. All captured BF16 outputs match GB10; every full replay endpoint preserves original raw FP32 while early stops preserve BF16. Full candidate masks, continuation identity/carry, completion partition, source/prepared words, metadata bounds and audit immutability, guards and unused tails are checked. Whole centers/errors are raw identical across the four new variants; their grouping differs from C64. Reference outputs are comparison inputs only. Repeated fixture CPU counts are deduplicated. Finite native tests do not establish a universal hardware error bound.
timing_scope: Five variants: original C64/full replay; whole-dot/full replay; whole-dot with four-part snapshots/full replay; two-part exact continuation; four-part exact continuation. One warmup plus three measured completed host samples rotate whole-operator order. Include original lossless preparation, eligibility, quarter metadata, producer, initial compaction/count read and every replay/continuation/compaction/count read. Allocation, clearing, canonical/reference computation, validation and explicit audits are outside clocks. All variants reserve the maximum snapshot, step-error and continuation capacity. Prefix clock includes preparation through initial selection; complete total includes replay. Captured q8192 repeats1023 rows of q7169 and is not a real-model token loop. QKV C64 is slower than the retained QKV matrix producer.

decision.reason: All generated/captured component and exact continuation checks pass. Whole-dot generator variants are substantially slower even with fewer interval evaluations and69VGPRs for the full-replay producer. Best OUT adds112.1279ms; best QKV adds135.0167ms over the C64 controls. Four-stage replay skips31.2205%/28.9995% of its own selected groups, but OUT still executes more groups than C64. Static assembly preserves zero-C WMMA plus explicit sums, shows no scratch accesses, and exposes many separately predicated16-bit operand loads and repeated input eligibility reads. It does not isolate a runtime cause.
decision.next_measured_question: Replace the scalar operand-loading loop with bounded contiguous vector loads and cache immutable input eligibility, comparing both the existing C64 producer and whole-dot variants. Require raw centers, intervals and complete replay/candidate parity and count the whole operator owner. Retain original fallback for any unsupported alignment.
